subject: Mini headroom bundle request — short-window uplift & reconciliation
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightlayer.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: priya@brightlayer.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: 48h burst headroom for Black Friday test

Hi Aditya,

We're running a targeted Black Friday A/B this week (small cohort, high concurrency) and expect a short burst above our committed tier. Can Redwood open a temporary headroom window for BrightLayer from Nov 4-5 (UTC) to cover up to ~120% of our committed qps? We'll provide a PO for the uplift and are asking whether you can grandfather a one-time smoothing credit for any overrun used during that window.

Two quick asks: 1) what's the day-rate for short-window headroom (one-off), and 2) can you confirm whether overrun tokens for that window would be eligible for a retro credit against next month's invoice if we hit a volume hurdle?

Attaching a brief snapshot of last week's usage for context.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Platform
BrightLayer

Attachments: BrightLayer_usage_snapshot_20271101-20271104.csv (text/csv)

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 48h burst headroom for Black Friday test

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads-up and the snapshot. Short answers up front so you can move fast: we can provide a short-window headroom bundle for Nov 4-5 and we can tie a one-time smoothing credit to it, subject to a small volume hurdle and a PO.

What I need from you to finalize:
- Confirm the exact window (start/end in UTC) and an expected qps peak.
- Issue the PO for the uplift (we can accept PO via email or DocuSign link).
- Agree to a simple reconciliation rule: if overrun tokens during the window are >20% of committed monthly usage, we grant a 30% smoothing credit on overrun token charges, applied against next invoice.

Pricing options I can offer for the uplift window:
A) Headroom bundle — fixed-day uplift fee of $3,500 + pay-as-you-go overrun at standard overrun rates (no retro credit unless threshold reached).
B) Headroom + smoothing — $2,200 fixed-day uplift (discounted) + overrun at standard rate, with the 30% smoothing credit applied retro if you clear the >20% hurdle. Requires PO and deal flagging in billing.

Ben, looping you and Laura for invoicing and legal/PO path.

I can push a short addendum to the order capturing the window and the smoothing rule once Samir confirms.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightlayer.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: priya@brightlayer.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 48h burst headroom for Black Friday test

Aditya — thanks, option B sounds closer to what we need. Confirming:
- Window: 2027-11-04 00:00 UTC to 2027-11-05 23:59 UTC
- Expected peak: ~1.15x committed qps, potential short spikes to 1.3x for a few minutes

We'll send a PO today for the Headroom + smoothing option (BL PO attached). Two clarifying questions before we lock:
1) For the >20% hurdle, is that evaluated on raw tokens or on billable tokens post-quantization/embedding normalization?
2) If we hit the smoothing credit, does the credit appear as a line item rebate or a negative invoice adjustment?

Thanks — Samir

Attachment: BrightLayer_PO_20271105.pdf (application/pdf)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, samir@brightlayer.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 48h burst headroom for Black Friday test

Samir / Aditya — quick clarifications from billing/legal side:
- Measurement: the >20% hurdle is evaluated on billable consumption (post any model-specific normalization we apply) — that's what goes to billing.
- Credit treatment: if BrightLayer clears the hurdle, we issue a negative line item on the subsequent invoice (i.e., a rebate applied in the next billing period), and we reference the PO/BL-2027-1123 in the memo.

Operational note: we'll flag the account for a temporary headroom key and create an isolated meter-tracking window so reconciliation is clean. Aditya, I'll need the PO number and a signed addendum to close the loop.

Ben Carter
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 48h burst headroom for Black Friday test — confirmed

Samir — received PO and signed addendum attached; we've provisioned the headroom bundle for the window you requested. Summary and next steps below:

Summary of terms (finalized):
- Window: 2027-11-04 00:00 UTC to 2027-11-05 23:59 UTC
- Option: Headroom + smoothing (discounted uplift) — fixed uplift fee $2,200; overrun billed at standard overrun rates; smoothing credit = 30% rebate on overrun charges if >20% billable overrun threshold hit during window.
- Reconciliation: isolated meter + usage snapshot will be sent by our billing team within 7 business days after window close. Credit, if applicable, will appear as a negative line item on your next invoice referencing BL-2027-1123.
- PO: BrightLayer_PO_20271105.pdf received (PO# BL-PO-7712).

Attachments included: signed addendum (via DocuSign), POV of expected reconciliation steps. Ben will follow up with the usage report and final invoice note.

Thanks for working quickly on this — good luck with the test and let us know if you need on-call support during the window.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
